name: Devouring Plague
summary: Devouring Plague is a rite of instruction offered to Forsaken priests who have proven their dedication to shadow magic. Granted by Priestess Aelthalyste in the Undercity, the teaching marks an acolyte's initiation into one of the most dreaded curses woven by the undead priesthood.

sections.title: A Curse of the Shadow
sections.body: In the murky cloisters of the War Quarter, Priestess Aelthalyste guides Forsaken practitioners through the grim arts of the Shadow. While living priests of other races appeal to the Holy Light or ancestral spirits for their power, the Forsaken have forged their own spiritual doctrines. Devouring Plague represents the crystallization of their philosophy: inflicting suffering upon their foes while leeching the stolen vitality back into their own decaying bodies.

sections.title: A Test of Mastery
sections.body: Aelthalyste does not offer the knowledge of the plague lightly. The spell is considered a weapon of potent malice, intended to turn the tide against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. When imparting the spell, Aelthalyste warns her disciples to hone their command over it through relentless practice, cautioning that far greater trials lie ahead for those who seek to master the dark arts.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what does devouring plague quest do
faq.answer: The quest serves as a formal lesson for Forsaken priests reaching seasoned standing. By speaking with Priestess Aelthalyste, the priest is taught how to cast Devouring Plague, a signature shadow affliction unique to undead practitioners.

Priestess Aelthalyste is a Forsaken priest trainer residing in the War Quarter of the Undercity. She oversees the development of emerging shadow casters and ensures they wield their destructive blessings effectively for the Forsaken.

faq.q: Can priests of other races learn Devouring Plague from Aelthalyste?
faq.answer: No. Devouring Plague is an esoteric spell exclusive to Forsaken priests. Trolls, humans, night elves, and dwarves commune with different spiritual forces and possess their own distinct racial teachings instead.

faq.q: Where do I turn in this quest?
faq.answer: Priestess Aelthalyste can be found in the War Quarter of the Undercity, lingering among the Forsaken's priest instructors and practitioners.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken priests specialize in plague and shadow magic?
faq.answer: Forsaken priests endure intense physical pain whenever they channel the Holy Light due to their undead state. As a result, many turn toward the teachings of the Shadow, using afflictions, curses, and stolen life-force to survive and wage war.

faq.q: What tests is Aelthalyste referring to?
faq.answer: Aelthalyste warns that as a priest grows in power, the trials faced across Lordaeron will intensify. Wielding dark magic invites dangerous scrutiny and deadly foes, demanding absolute command over every curse in an acolyte's repertoire.

angles.text: This rite provides Forsaken priests with one of their most iconic racial spells, binding their survival directly to the affliction they inflict on enemies.
Embracing plague-like shadowcraft reflects the Forsaken's divergence from traditional Lordaeron worship following the Third War.
While other Horde allies rely on ancestral spirits or elemental balance, the Forsaken bring ruthless, disease-like curses into the faction's collective arsenal.
